name: file-upload
title: File upload
description: Choose photos and PDFs and watch each one arrive. Files too large are refused in plain words beside the field, a dropped file keeps its bar where it stopped and offers Try again, and a Received stamp lands once every file is safe. Each bar reads 99% until the server confirms, so the warm kolam closes only when the file has really arrived. Driven by a pure, seeded fake transport you swap for your own.
